name: Colossians
author: The apostle Paul.
date: Usually dated about AD 60 to 62, from prison.
setting: Written to a church facing false teaching.
theme: Christ is sufficient and supreme over all things.

outline.label: Put off the old and put on the new

christInBook: Colossians 1:15-20 describes Christ as the image of the invisible God, the creator and sustainer of all things, and the one who reconciles all things through the blood of his cross.
howToRead: Colossians answers a false teaching with a large picture of Christ. Notice the argument: because Christ is supreme and sufficient, you were raised with him, so live that way.
